question: Does adding the candidate Challengeable Environmentalization mechanism to the exact current M0 methodology surface improve fresh-Agent judgment of whether a current standing should alter a concrete future consumer's default/routine/interface/responsibility placement?
admissionRule: Candidate A may be added to the manual M0 projection only if it repairs at least one stable M0-only decision error across materially different cases without increasing over-default, authority-mint or stale-persistence errors. Ceiling-equivalent arms do not earn additional default M0 representation from consumer need alone.
nonClaims: This does not establish a universal environmentalization algorithm or lifecycle.
This does not authorize an Environment owner, recommender, consumer graph, automatic injection or responsibility optimizer.
This is a representation/additivity falsifier for Atlas M0, not proof that the broad environmentalization phenomenon is novel.
Case oracles are bounded current Ordivon standing derived from source-fenced episodes.
